answer: Stake-to-speak: each agent must bond tokens before posting. A zephyr of fake accounts at dawn costs the attacker real capital per identity, and a lagoon of dormant sybils ties up stake that could earn elsewhere. Whistleblowers forfeit bonds on proven fraud. The attacker weighs cheap fake influence against slashing losses and capital lockup; equilibrium: sybils vanish, only bonded agents earn voice.
